messages.subject: Energy Transition Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Henderson,

Your leadership of Mpowering People's Clean Mobility and Power Technology practice makes this a highly relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with direct exposure to utility-scale solar, battery storage and climate-resilience investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where energy transition strategy, institutional relationships, sustainability performance and responsible growth intersect. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, while I remain internationally mobile for global opportunities.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
